{{Quote|Lord Azard, we will have to lower the shielding around the deployment hatch in order to deploy the Sharks.|Unnamed lieutenant to [[Darth Azard]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 33">[[Legacy (2006) 33|''Legacy'' (2006) 33]]</ref>}}
This '''unnamed Imperial lieutenant''' was an [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|Imperial swimmer]] [[Vehicle Command Crewer|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] who served on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in [[137 ABY]] during [[Darth Krayt]]'s campaign against the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], one of whom betrayed the Empire by letting the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] steal an Imperial star destroyer from the orbital shipyards. He piloted the personal swimmer of [[Darth Azard]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] scientist [[Vul Isen]]. He was killed when a Mon Cal piloted his Krakana into the deployment hatch of the swimmer, destroying it (though Azard and Vul Isen survived).

==Biography==
At some point the unnamed lieutenant was trained to pilot Imperial swimmers in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] fractured in two (the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] and the [[Fel Empire]]) he served the Sith, under [[Darth Krayt]].

In [[137 ABY]], as response to a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] aiding the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] in stealing an Advanced Star Destroyer from the orbital shipyards, Darth Krayt ordered the extermination and detainment of all Mon Calamari in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide of the Mon Cal]] commenced on the planet of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], an Imperial Army aquatic unit was deployed under [[Darth Azard]]. When [[Vul Isen]], a Sith scientist, created the [[Sea Leviathan]] creature to use against the Mon Calamari refugees and the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]], him and Darth Azard personally lead the Leviathan to the refugee/ranger base in an Imperial swimmer, piloted by the lieutenant.

When they were attacked by the Rangers, and their [[Imperial Knight]] military advisor, they decided to deploy the [[Shark underwater fighter]]s held in the swimmer. To do so, they lowered the shielding around the deployment hatch. A Mon Cal piloting a [[Krakana underwater fighter]] went kamikaze and rammed the open deployment hatch, destroying the swimmer. The head of the swimmer broke off and landed on the sea floor. Though the scientist and Lord Azard survived, the lieutenant was slumped over the controls, and if he didn't die on impact, he was killed later when Vul Isen broke the glass window of the cockpit, flooding it and drowning the lieutenant if he survived the impact.

==Personality and traits==
The lieutenant respected the two Sith that he piloted the swimmer for. He was cautious, reminding the Sith that to deploy the Sharks they would needed to lower the shielding around the hatch, making that part of the swimmer vulnerable to attack. His theory proved correct when a Mon Cal rammed the deployment hatch and destroyed the swimmer.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial lieutenant's lone appearance is in [[Star Wars: Legacy|''Legacy'']]{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc.
